'''Jurgen Nath's Hideout''' was a bunker on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The hideout was controlled by [[Jurgen Nath]] and his group of [[Jurgen's bandits|bandits]].<ref name="SWG:V" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Narmle Militia]] was able to confirm the presence of Vladlun Travan in the bunker and gave this information to [[Wernell Covington]] whose daughter [[Felicia]] had been murdered by Travan years ago. Covington sent a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to the hideout and the latter killed Vladlun Travan to avenge the murder of Covington's daughter.<ref name="SWG:V" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jurgen Nath's Hideout was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="SWG:V" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Jurgen Nath's Hideout was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 12|Game Update 12]]," on [[August 10]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 12: Engineering Trader">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=976424|text=Game Update 12: Engineering Trader}}</ref>
